content: अभिज्ञा €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To recognize, discern; (सा) नाभ्यजानान्नलं नृपम् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 To know, understand, be acquainted with, be aware of, perceive; अहं हि नाभिजानामि भवेदेवं न वेति वा <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Bg. 18. 55</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">4. 14</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">7. 13</ls>; भवदभिज्ञातं कथयतु <ls>Dk. 3</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">78</ls>. .²3 To look upon, consider or regard as, know to be. .²4 To admit, own, acknowledge; न पुत्रमभिजानामि त्वयि जातम् <ls>Mb. 5</ls> To remember; recollect; used with the Future instead of the Imperfect. Imperfect with यत्, or both when interdependence of two actions is denoted, <ls>P. III. 2. 112, 114</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Bk. 6. 138</ls>, <ls n="Bk. 6.">139</ls>.
